name: Rates: floating drop
description: Rates x10 (docs/RATES_PLAN.md): drop and spoil of monsters out of extra stock rolls (hook P7-DROP-FLOAT): item chance 3 x F (F = level curve x mob level difference, party = highest level), stackables x1..x3 skewed low, weapons/armour/recipes/enchants/life stones/soul crystals always 1, adena exactly x5, raids chance x2, epics stock; valuable quest rewards x1 (hook P7-QUEST-REWARD). XP/SP/quests/manor: Rates.ini override of the profile.

Enabled.description: Off = stock drop and spoil (x1) and stock quest rewards; the Rates.ini rates (XP x10 ...) stay.

AdenaRate.description: Adena from ordinary monsters: exactly this many times the stock roll (never floating). Launcher: 'Adena'.

RaidAdena.description: Adena from raid bosses x this (epic bosses: stock).

DropChance.description: Item chance of the death drop = this x F (extra stock rolls; stock chance multipliers stay 1). Launcher: 'Drop'.

SpoilChance.description: Item chance of the spoil = this x F. Launcher: 'Spoil'.

RaidChance.description: Item chance of raid bosses (no F, amounts stock); epic bosses (grand bosses) are always stock.

AmountMax.description: Stackable items (resources, materials, recipe parts, crystals, shots, ...) x1..x this per rolled line, skewed low, independent of F.

AmountSkew.description: Amount = 1 + (AmountMax - 1) x u^skew (1 = even; 2 = mean 1.67 for x3).

DiffCurve.description: F by mob level minus level (on top of the stock grey-mob penalty).

FClamp.description: F = clamp(level x diff, min, max).

MaxExtraRolls.description: Cap of extra stock rolls per kill.

StatsInterval.description: RATES statistics line in the log (0 = never).

SelfTest.description: Smoke test only: 3000 simulated kills of monsters of level 20/40/60, stock against floating averages (SELFTEST lines).
